name: Starter rule base
description: Descriptive indicators of how a drawing compares with the others on the measured quantities.

indicators.name: Amount drawn
indicators.rationale: How much was drawn compared with the others: the number of strokes and the total length of the lines.

rules.if: strokesDrawn is high and totalLength is high
rules.rationale: Many strokes and long lines both point to a large drawing.

rules.if: strokesDrawn is high or totalLength is high
rules.rationale: One of the two measures alone is a weaker hint, for example a few very long lines.

rules.if: strokesDrawn is medium or totalLength is medium
rules.rationale: Either measure in the middle of the group means a typical amount.

rules.if: strokesDrawn is low and totalLength is low
rules.rationale: Few strokes and short lines both point to a small drawing.

rules.if: strokesDrawn is low or totalLength is low
rules.rationale: One of the two measures alone is a weaker hint.

indicators.name: Use of space
indicators.rationale: How much room the drawing takes: the volume of its bounding box and its height range.

rules.if: boundingVolume is high and heightRange is high
rules.rationale: A large box and a large height range both mean the drawing reaches far.

rules.if: boundingVolume is high or heightRange is high
rules.rationale: One stray stroke can enlarge the box, so one measure alone is only a weak hint.

rules.if: boundingVolume is medium or heightRange is medium
rules.rationale: Either measure in the middle of the group means a typical use of space.

rules.if: boundingVolume is low and heightRange is low
rules.rationale: A small box and a small height range both mean the drawing stays close together.

rules.if: boundingVolume is low or heightRange is low
rules.rationale: One measure alone is a weaker hint. Depends also on how far the participant can reach.

indicators.name: Drawing pace
indicators.rationale: How fast the lines were drawn, from the mean drawing speed.

rules.if: meanSpeed is high
rules.rationale: A high mean speed compared with the others is a fast pace.

rules.if: meanSpeed is medium
rules.rationale: A mean speed in the middle of the group is a typical pace.

rules.if: meanSpeed is low
rules.rationale: A low mean speed compared with the others is a slow pace. It can be careful or hesitant.

indicators.name: Pauses
indicators.rationale: How much time passed between the strokes (pauses of more than 5 seconds).

rules.if: idleTime is high
rules.rationale: A lot of time between strokes compared with the others. The data cannot say what the participant did.

rules.if: idleTime is medium
rules.rationale: A pause time in the middle of the group.

rules.if: idleTime is low
rules.rationale: Little time between the strokes compared with the others.

indicators.name: Self-correction
indicators.rationale: How many of the strokes were erased again.

rules.if: eraseRatio is high
rules.rationale: A large share of erased strokes compared with the others. It can reflect self-correction or trying out.

rules.if: eraseRatio is medium
rules.rationale: A share of erased strokes in the middle of the group.

rules.if: eraseRatio is low
rules.rationale: Few or no erased strokes compared with the others.

indicators.name: Colour variety
indicators.rationale: How many clearly different colours were used.

rules.if: distinctColours is high
rules.rationale: More distinct colours than most of the others.

rules.if: distinctColours is medium
rules.rationale: A number of colours in the middle of the group.

rules.if: distinctColours is low
rules.rationale: Fewer distinct colours than most of the others, for example one colour only.

indicators.name: Colour warmth
indicators.rationale: The share of warm colours (red, orange, yellow, pink) in the coloured ink.

levels.medium: a mix of warm and cool colours

rules.if: warmShare is high
rules.rationale: A high share of warm ink compared with the others. The meaning of colours differs between people.

rules.if: warmShare is medium
rules.rationale: A share of warm ink in the middle of the group.

rules.if: warmShare is low
rules.rationale: A low share of warm ink compared with the others.

indicators.name: Line character
indicators.rationale: Whether the lines are long and smooth, or short and winding.

levels.medium: lines of a typical length and shape

rules.if: meanStrokeLength is low and directionalChange is high
rules.rationale: Short strokes that change direction a lot make a fragmented, winding line.

rules.if: meanStrokeLength is high and directionalChange is low
rules.rationale: Long strokes that change direction little make a calm, smooth line.

rules.if: meanStrokeLength is medium and directionalChange is medium
rules.rationale: Both measures in the middle of the group.

rules.if: meanStrokeLength is low or directionalChange is high
rules.rationale: One of the two alone is only a weak hint.

rules.if: meanStrokeLength is high or directionalChange is low
rules.rationale: One of the two alone is only a weak hint.
